title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5-Inch Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Vanity Top Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5-Inch, Fire Engine Red
description:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when wall space is limited—this vanity top toilet tissue holder adds convenient storage right on the counter in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.

Highlights
- Save wall space in smaller bathrooms with a countertop vanity top design
- Keep a toilet paper roll accessible beside the sink for everyday use
- Choose long-lasting durability with solid brass construction
- Coordinate your look with the vanity top accessories collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 x 6 x 5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 10 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 5 lbs
- Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
